svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.17.1 Installation
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: Tiles cut back to show the battens and sheathing
"Concrete Roof Tiles." The standard sets how the tiles are installed. Its content is not reproduced on this sheet.
Sets when continuous roof sheathing is installed to support the roofing. This Article applies subject to it.

svg.text: concrete roof tiles are installed according to
Drawn: flat tiles on battens over sheathing, tile shape, size and batten spacing illustration only. Note A-9.26.17.1.(1) is not reproduced.
